equations.name: Kp(T) correlation attributed to Yin et al. 2004
equations.expression: AS PRINTED: Kp = exp[(40100 - 25.46 T ln T + 0.00917 T^2 - 103000/T + 64.81 T)/(R T)]. Probable correct form: Kp = exp(-dG0(T)/(R T)) with dG0(T) = 40100 - 25.46 T ln T + 0.00917 T^2 - 103000/T + 64.81 T [J/mol]
equations.applies_to: cross-check only; corrected form gives Kp=2.97 (500 K), 102 (700 K), 647 (873 K) (AmCraX calculation); original: Yin, Zhang, Xu, Zhu, Ng & Au (2004) J. Catal. 224, 384

limitations: Secondary review: all catalyst, kinetic, membrane and economic numbers are quoted from other works; cite originals.
Kp correlations Eqs. 3-5 contain typographical errors (missing minus sign in Eq. 3; Eq. 5 as printed gives negative Kp; Eq. 4 bracketing ambiguous).
Standard thermodynamic values (Eq. 1) uncited and internally inconsistent by ~0.16 kJ/mol.
Table 5 pre-exponential factors have inconsistent/implausible units and no pressure units; Itoh kf unit printed as 'mmol s/(kg_cat MPa)'.
Rate constants for Itoh LH model and Fang power law not given numerically.
No Sieverts-law expression, permeance or permeability values, and no PSA data in this review.
Some Table 7 entries conflict with the text or with the original authors' own review (Itoh 2014 temperature/pressure; Cechetto 2021 pressure).
relevance: Source of mechanism/RDS discussion, Temkin-Pyzhev and power-law rate forms with reaction orders/E_app for Ru-K/CaO (Sayas 2020) and Ni/Ba-Al-O (Im 2020) for amcrax.kinetics (K0 values must be retrieved from originals); Kp(T) correlations as cross-checks for amcrax.thermodynamics; high-pressure conversion data (1-40 bar) relevant to 20 bar baseline; HRF definitions and membrane reactor benchmarks for amcrax.separation; LCOH and CO2 intensity literature values for economics/environmental comparison (literature label only).
